description: Billet benchmark corpus (SPEC.md 5.1): real STEP models, downloaded by bench/runner/billet_bench.py fetch into bench/corpus/ and verified by SHA-256. No model is committed.
selection: 33 of 58 verified candidates: 15 large (over 20 MB), 11 mid (1 to 20 MB) and 7 small parts. Excluded: non-commercial licenses, a license needing review, and assemblies over 60 MB, whose cost per benchmark run was too high. Per-model job rules are in docs/billet/decisions.md.
